title: DigitalBridge and IFM take Switch private for $11B

sources.quote: funds affiliated with the investment management platform of DigitalBridge and an affiliate of IFM Investors acquired all outstanding common shares of Switch, Inc.
for $34.25 per share in cash, or approximately $11 billion, including the repayment of outstanding debt.

explain: DigitalBridge's investment funds and Australian pension investor IFM bought data center operator Switch for $34.25 a share, about $11 billion including debt. The full price is shown on this record; IFM's share is not split out.
